title: Variant gating walkthrough - compact screens and interactive tour assets
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design and deliver a compact, mobile-first walkthrough and interactive tour for the Rollouts product that focuses on 'variant gating' — a simplified concept that groups canary, A/B, and fallback behaviour under a single user flow. Deliverables: responsive mockups (mobile and desktop), an interactive prototype for the first-time quickstart, a short how-to screenshot set for docs, iconography and microcopy, export-ready assets for engineering handoff, and a validation checklist for accessibility and localization. Acceptance criteria: prototypes validate within 1 moderated usability session with PM/SEs, screenshots imported into docs with no cropping issues, and engineering confirms asset sizes + tokens for the first implementation sprint.
assets: 4 responsive mockups: mobile narrow (360px), mobile wide (430px), tablet (768px), desktop (1200px)
3 interactive hotspots for the tour (tooltip, modal, inline-banner)
SVG icon set (6 icons) + Lottie micro-animation for 'fallback engage'
PNG screenshot set for docs (2x and 3x for mobile), exported and named per docs convention
design tokens JSON (colors/typography/spacers) exported for engineering
tasks: Finalize content hierarchy for the compact tour and validate with PM (due 2026-03-05)
Produce first-pass mobile mockups and prototype interactions (due 2026-03-08)
Run 1 moderated usability session with 5 participants and capture time-to-complete metrics (due 2026-03-10)
Iterate on copy and accessibility issues based on research (due 2026-03-11)
Export assets and handoff to Engineering with tokens and spec sheet (due 2026-03-14)
Create screenshots and update docs quickstart page (due 2026-03-17)
updates: 2026-03-03: Kickoff sync with PM and Eng. Agreed to reframe 'pin' language to 'gating' to reduce endpoint confusion and make the UX concept more approachable for non-ML engineers. Action: update microcopy and prototype labels.
2026-03-05: Wireframes completed for mobile narrow and tablet. UX review requested — noted concerns about cognitive load in the banner step; reduced paragraphs to 1-2 lines.

2026-03-07: Prototype v0.1 live in Figma. Interactive hotspots implemented for canary preview and fallback step. Shared with SEs for technical feasibility: Liam Chen confirmed the component can be built with existing modal + feature-flag hooks (see handoff link).

2026-03-09: Usability session scheduled and run (remote moderated, 6 participants including two platform engineers). Key finding: participants expected a toggle to 'preview traffic' before enabling gating. PM asked to add a lightweight preview step in tour - added as v0.2.

2026-03-11: Design critique with Design Lead (Maya Thompson) and PM (Jordan Blake). Feedback: tighten copy, add accessible focus states for the stepper, and supply alt-text for Lottie animations. Estimate +1 day for updates.
2026-03-12: v0.2 prototype uploaded and annotated. Engineering handoff session booked for 2026-03-13. Created initial GitHub design PR for asset exports.
accessibility_notes: Contrast checks completed for key CTA states. Added keyboard focus order and aria labels for each interactive tour element. Lottie animation will have reduced-motion variant. Localization-ready copy tokens prepared; max line length ~60 chars for mobile.
review_feedback: Jordan Blake (2026-03-05): Love the 'preview before enabling' addition. Ask: can we show expected latency and cost delta in the preview step?
Liam Chen (2026-03-07): Technical note: fallback Lottie should be optional; we'll substitute an SVG for initial MVP to save bundle size.
Maya Thompson (2026-03-11): Approve visual direction pending small copy edits and accessibility fixes.
